verdict.rationale: mise documents non-interactive tool installs and updates. CI scripts run `mise install` and `mise install --locked` unattended, `mise outdated` and `mise upgrade` handle updates, and `mise lock --bump --dry-run --json` gives a machine-readable preview. However, the interactive trust prompt is shown, and exit-code and error semantics for install/upgrade are not documented; the only exit-status documentation covers an unrelated bootstrap status command. missing for 10: documented exit codes for install/upgrade failures, documented structured error output, explicit non-interactive mode for the trust prompt, independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent install and update project dependencies non-interactively, with clear exit codes and errors when something fails

citations.quote: Commit a lockfile and install with `mise install --locked`. Every job then installs the same versions
Show tools with newer versions `mise outdated` Upgrade within the configured request `mise upgrade node`
